source: Oxford Insights, Government AI Readiness Index 2024 (December 2024)
license: Cited per Oxford Insights terms; overall scores transcribed from the published report's per-country results table (188 jurisdictions, 40 indicators across the Government, Technology Sector, and Data & Infrastructure pillars).
notes: Overall Government AI Readiness score (0-100) for the 13 of 14 M-PAPI middle powers present in GAIRI 2024. The EU bloc (EUU) is the only non-covered jurisdiction (GAIRI scores sovereign states, not the EU bloc); Taiwan IS covered (74.58). Each value cross-checked against the report's regional prose (e.g. Singapore 84.25, France 79.36 'narrowly ahead of the United Kingdom 78.88', Israel 74.52, UAE 75.66). This series is used ONLY as an independent external concurrent-validity benchmark in section 16.12 and is NOT an input to the M-PAPI composite (no circularity).
